direction: Hyperrealistic advertising product photograph for a premium espresso bar menu. products.generationPrompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one original square hyperrealistic premium commercial product photograph for ROFÉ's existing warm neutral espresso bar menu collection. Subject: one authentic hot cappuccino in a rounded ivory/cream ceramic coffee cup with right-side handle on a matching ceramic saucer. Espresso and steamed milk under a generous fine velvety milk foam layer, with a delicate natural even dusting of cinnamon across the foam and a slim caramel coffee border. Clearly a cappuccino, distinct from a latte with rosetta art: no leaf/rosetta drawing, no whipped cream, no mound or dessert topping. Appetizing realistic fine foam bubbles and porcelain reflections. Camera three-quarter view slightly above cup, centered product filling around 65–75 percent of square frame, cup and saucer fully in frame with breathing room. Seamless warm beige/cream background with subtle gradient, matte light warm stone tabletop, soft diffused studio key light from left with gentle fill and grounded soft shadows. Restrained warm caramel/ivory palette, clean photorealistic advertising art direction, same premium studio feeling as an espresso/latte catalog. Only cup, coffee, saucer and a trace of soft steam. No text, logo, watermark, brands, hands, people, spoon, napkin, cinnamon sticks, loose coffee beans or other props. Square 1:1, at least 1024 pixels per side.
